NVDA.name: NVIDIA Corporation
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以CUDA和Blackwell架构为核心，打造数据中心规模的全栈AI基础设施平台。
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Platform strategy delivering data center scale AI infrastructure via CUDA and Blackwell full-stack co-design.
concrete_bets: Extreme co-design of chips, networking, systems and software

MSFT.name: Microsoft Corporation
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以智能云和Copilot为核心，将AI贯穿全栈并负责任地赋能企业与个人生产力。
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Infuse AI across the full stack via Azure and Copilot to responsibly empower productivity.
concrete_bets: Azure intelligent cloud and edge AI platform

PLTR.name: Palantir Technologies Inc.
PLTR.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 通过AIP将生成式AI模型与企业及政府现有平台（Gotham、Foundry、Apollo）整合，打造企业级AI操作系统。
PLTR.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Integrate generative AI with Gotham, Foundry, and Apollo via AIP to deliver an enterprise AI operating system.

META.name: Meta Platforms, Inc.
META.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以AI驱动社交与沉浸式体验，赋能内容排序与发现，并拓展Meta AI助手及AI眼镜等硬件生态。
META.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Powers social and immersive experiences with AI, enhancing ranking, discovery, Meta AI assistant, and AI glasses.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 围绕编码类智能体的工具、代码质量门槛、本地开放模型与记忆机制展开。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Covers coding agents, quality bars, local open-model harnesses, and agent memory.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 聚焦缩放律、递归自改进、循环 Transformer、推理强度与微调方法等基础研究。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Focuses on scaling laws, recursive self-improvement, looped transformers, reasoning effort, and fine-tuning.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 展示 GPT-6 Astra、Codex、Data agent 等在金融、科研、政府与企业数据场景的部署。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Shows GPT-6 Astra, Codex, and data agents deployed across finance, science, government, and enterprise data.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 涉及智能体攻击、文本水印检测、LLM 基准测量与网络安全评测模式。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Covers agent attacks, watermark detection, benchmark measurement, and cybersecurity eval patterns.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 涵盖全双工语音 API、多模态编码器/手势生成，以及基因组、脑图谱、气候、健康等科学基础模型。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Includes full-duplex voice, multimodal encoders/gestures, and science foundation models for genomics, connectomics, climate, and health.
